## Description
What changes and why.

## Type of change
- [ ] Content or copy (`src/content/`)
- [ ] Design or layout (`src/components/`, `src/styles/`)
- [ ] Site facts and links (`src/config/site.ts`)
- [ ] Policy text (privacy policy, terms of use)
- [ ] CI, build or tooling
- [ ] Dependencies

## Related issue
Closes #(issue number)

## How has this been tested?
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (`astro check` and the production build)
- [ ] Checked in a browser with `npm run preview`
- [ ] Both themes, and the choice survives a reload
- [ ] Reduced-motion mode: nothing animates
- [ ] No Content-Security-Policy violation in the console
- [ ] Not applicable: the change does not touch what the site serves

## Checklist
- [ ] Copy changes are in `src/content/copy.yml`; links and addresses in `src/config/site.ts`
- [ ] No new origin is loaded; if one is, the CSP and the privacy policy say so
- [ ] No backend, form, cookie or third-party script is introduced
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, one topic per commit

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Before and after, in both themes when the change is visual.
